scope: One registry-lock/CAS reservation of an exact settled ready Claude helper. Pins its nonce, current desired target, source and raw provider subtree; does not publish credentials or change actual authority.

negative_controls: Ready identity/expiry/scopes validation omitted: runtime RED.
First Retire pin omitted: runtime RED before ready-intent mutation.
Second Retire pin omitted: runtime RED in defensive recovered-pin fixture before intent deletion.
Provider bytes remarshaled: runtime RED on preserved whitespace/unknown fields.
Legacy writer exclusion omitted: runtime RED.
Pending-relogin guard omitted: runtime RED after public Relogin write failure left old grant plus ready receipt.
tests.method: Ignored source copies and Go overlays only; bounded local sleep stand-ins for process custody, not native/systemd qualification.

review.author: Sol 6.1; TDD and omission controls
review.independent: Astra scoped GREEN after final pending-relogin fix and actual failed-public-Relogin regression.
review.root: Connected code review, complete logins race, all-package build, connected vet and logins lint.

limits: No production bootstrap, publication, client adoption, migration or activation exists in this slice.
Current-revision cross-account reservation only; staged same-account replacement needs its separate reviewed custody representation.
Legacy unbound holds remain held and are never upgraded using a current helper nonce.
A ready receipt may outlive its original attempt deadline and historical selection; its current grant, exact ref, identity, scope and expiry are revalidated.
This does not complete issue39 or any native coherence gate.
